title: Lowest Error, Best Decision? Code and supplementary material for evaluating remaining useful life models for turbofan maintenance
description: Code, model predictions, results and supplementary material accompanying the paper 'Lowest Error, Best Decision? Accuracy Equivalence and Lead-Time-Dependent Rankings of Remaining Useful Life Models for Turbofan Maintenance' (ISDIA 2027). The repository reproduces every reported result on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan benchmark: engine-grouped cross-validation of four tabular regressors and a 1D-CNN reference, practical equivalence testing of accuracy, a decision lens with alarm margins calibrated to a common miss target under nested engine-grouped validation, and bootstrap intervals that include margin re-estimation.
